text.en: 1. This Order may be cited as the Banking (Qualifying Subsidiary) (Transitional Provision) Order 2001.

heading.en: Extension of period of exemption for qualifying subsidiary

text.en: 2. The period of exemption, from the capital requirements for a qualifying subsidiary, referred to in section 9A(7) of the Act is extended to end on 17th October 2001.
